note: The views of plan 0008 (D4, R8, PT-60). tools/geo/build.py casts rays from each eye to the targets against the ground of the DEM and writes data/geo/build/place_views.json. PT-60 casts the same rays against the ground of the game. An eye is a landmark (its position, or the end of its outline to the "side"), "out_m" meters toward the sea from it, at "height_m" over the ground (over the sea level for an eye on the sea). A target is the top of a place: its ground plus "top_m". A ray goes to each of "samples" points from the ground of the target to its top; the part of the points that the eye sees is the result.
